definition: Something made by combining different things together.
exampleSentence: The cake batter was a mixture of flour, sugar and eggs.

definition: A feeling of happiness or enjoyment.
exampleSentence: Reading in the garden was one of her greatest pleasures.
It took her a while to find the solution to the puzzle.

definition: A person who plays a musical instrument.
exampleSentence: The musician practised the violin for hours every day.

definition: Not ordinary; important or different in a good way.
exampleSentence: Grandma made a special cake for my birthday.
The dog let out a vicious growl at the stranger.
The maths homework was quite difficult this week.

definition: Something taken to help you get better when you're ill.
exampleSentence: The doctor gave him medicine for his cough.

definition: Specific, or relating to one thing rather than others in general.
exampleSentence: She was very particular about how her books were arranged.
The children sat in a circle for story time.

definition: A period of one hundred years.
exampleSentence: The old castle was built almost a century ago.

definition: Able to happen or be done.
exampleSentence: Is it possible to finish the project by Friday?
The actual cost was much higher than we expected.

definition: A single person, or relating to just one person.
exampleSentence: Each individual pupil received their own certificate.

definition: The substance something is made from, or fabric.
exampleSentence: The curtains were made from a soft, thick material.
